Earlier current/year and F04a single-version conflicts, latest-year draft/historical/tie holds, numeric-version positives and hash-bound human/stale precedence remain. A valid human may select an older year; stale candidate decisions hold.

Year-only families stay present in the version graph but outside Reader/answer Evidence; unrelated sources remain eligible, hold counts and binding are retained, and synthetic source bytes remain unchanged.

A synthetic all-held rebuild raises the real in-process Reader CLI failure before index projection, preserving previous CONFIG/index and source bytes. This does not attest those earlier sources as current or fix shared review/publication binding.

Final executor runs pass pure11 (10 acceptance/control +1 residual witness), resolver/Reader20 and app E2E17. Root collateral13+7+8 on Python3.14 and native XLSX security1 on Python3.9 pass, no skips/expected failures. Positive bob answer and final-audit assertions remain. Frozen actual RED5 failures and one intermediate E2E error are retained.

Year-only holding is a bounded safety improvement, not confirmed independent annual retention. Current-marker/year and multi-token cases, unsignalled candidates, independent partition, shared review/HITL generation/revision, temporal freshness and full product acceptance remain open. README reflects these limits; no real data/model, full package, global race or total-resource claim.
